history.summary: A 1,593sqft freehold 4BR at The Esta, D15, asking $4.15M / $2,605 psf — a slight premium to the $2,542 URA median — with a healthy 6.6%/yr appreciation on a solid 59-txn series. The fundamentals are good but the $4.15M price sits well above the liquid sweet spot, which is what the low score_1000 (339) is flagging.
history.rating_rationale: Genuinely strong appreciation (6.6%/yr on 59 txn, high confidence), freehold, established seafront-adjacent D15 project, 640m to Tanjong Katong TEL — all real positives. The offsets are the $4.15M price (a thin >$3M buyer pool that lengthens exit time), a slight +2.5% premium to median, and a compact 1,593sqft for a 4BR. Good asset, but the exit-liquidity drag at this price keeps it at Neutral for a 5-7yr investment hold.
red_flags: $4.15M — well past the deepest-liquidity band, longer exit
catalysts: Strong 6.6%/yr appreciation on a deep 59-txn series
